_about: Recorded judge verdicts for src/eval/cases.ts, one per case id: the SKU the judge picks from the candidate list, or null for none. HAND-WRITTEN in the build session, not recorded from a model (no API key was available): each verdict imitates a careful judge that sees only the customer's line and the candidate list (SKU, description, pack). Re-record with the real judge: `npm run eval:record` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
